caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a rustic appearance, positioned centrally on a cream or beige background. The chair has a high back with two horizontal slats and four slightly angled legs connected by horizontal rungs. The wood is depicted in natural, weathered colors with tones of brown and hints of green, indicative of age or exposure to the elements. The seat appears to be made of woven material, such as straw or rush, and is shown with areas of significant wear and damage, particularly on the front left corner where part of the material is missing. The chair casts no visible shadow, and there are no additional objects or elements in the composition. In the lower right corner, the artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," is present.
title: Child's High Chair
